title: Multiple inheritance in Java
answer: Java does not allow a class to extend multiple classes, so multiple inheritance of implementation through superclasses is not supported. A class can implement multiple interfaces, and interfaces can extend multiple interfaces, which provides multiple type inheritance without inheriting conflicting class state. AeroTopo's `Product` implements both `Exportable` and `Identified`, while `Units` implements both `Left` and `Right` and resolves their default-method conflict explicitly.
